issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md specifies Stock.add(String) with return type void, but both the template and solution implement Stock.add(String) returning int. This creates an API contract mismatch between the specification and the provided code, making it unclear to students what signature to implement and what tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent: either update the UML to "+add(String): int" (and document what the int means), or change Stock.add in both template and solution to return void and update all call sites accordingly.

issues.description: The problem statement asks to "add getters for all the private fields" and the UML for Stock does not show any setter for the stockIngredients field, but both template and solution expose a public setStockIngredients(...). This contradicts the encapsulation guidance and may mislead students into relying on a setter that is not part of the specified API.
issues.suggestedFix: Either update the UML/text to explicitly allow setStockIngredients (e.g., for demo/testing), or remove the public setter from template/solution and adjust Main/demo code to use only the specified Stock methods.

issues.description: SealSaloon.stock is inconsistent between UML and text: the UML/diagram shows a non-static Stock association/field on SealSaloon, but the written requirements explicitly state that the stock attribute must be static and shared across instances; the solution implements it as static final. This can confuse students about whether each SealSaloon has its own Stock or all saloons share one.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the spec contradiction by updating the UML to mark stock as static (e.g., {static}/underlined) and reflect a shared association, or remove the 'static stock' requirement from the text and change the implementation to an instance-level final Stock consistently.
